title: IV fluid tonicity

findings.where: tonicity.jsx: Dot and Drop components; particle samples and water symbols in both themes
findings.title: Meaning-bearing symbols fall below the required 4.5:1 contrast
findings.problem: Dot uses fillOpacity={0.75} and Drop uses fillOpacity={0.85}. With the supplied theme tokens, some solute dots over the cell gradient and water drops over the card background have approximately 3.7–4.2:1 contrast. These symbols encode concentration and water, rather than serving only as decoration.
findings.fix: Render solute dots in opaque C.ink and water symbols in opaque C.teal. Check contrast against the actual composited backgrounds in both themes.

assessment: No clinical blocker identified. One minor violation of the project's contrast requirement.
